text:
```yaml
name: Verify DCO Sign-off

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ master ]

jobs:
  check-dco:
    name: Check DCO Sign-off
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Check Commits for DCO Sign-off
        id: dco-check
        run: |
          echo "Checking commits for DCO sign-off..."
          
          # Get all non-merge commits in the PR
          COMMITS=$(git log --pretty=format:"%H" ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}..${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }} --no-merges)
          
          FAILED_COMMITS=()
          for commit in $COMMITS; do
            # Check if commit has DCO sign-off
            if ! git show --format="%B" "$commit" | grep -q "Signed-off-by:"; then
              FAILED_COMMITS+=("$commit")
            fi
          done
          
          if [ ${#FAILED_COMMITS[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
            echo "❌ The following commits are missing DCO sign-off:"
            for commit in "${FAILED_COMMITS[@]}"; do
              echo "- $commit"
            done
            echo ""
            echo "To fix this, please sign off your commits by running:"
            echo "  git commit --amend --signoff"
            echo "Or for multiple commits:"
            echo "  git rebase --signoff <commit-hash>"
            exit 1
          else
            echo "✅ All commits have DCO sign-off"
          fi
```
